=You are an expert financial analyst conducting due diligence on {{ $json.company_name }}.

COMPANY INFORMATION:
- Name: {{ $json.company_name }}
- Website: {{ $json.website || 'Not provided' }}
- Description: {{ $json.description || 'Not provided' }}

ATTACHMENT CONTENT:
{{ $json.attachment_text || 'No additional documents provided' }}

PREVIOUSLY COMPLETED SECTIONS:
{{ $json.existing_sections || 'None yet' }}

TASK: Generate the "{{ $json.section_title }}" section for this due diligence report.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Be specific and factual based on the provided information
- If attachment content is available, incorporate relevant details
- Minimum 300 words
- Professional analysis format
- Include key metrics and insights where possible
- Reference the company's actual business model and industry
- Use real information from attachments when available
